messages:
alyssa: heads up — we've got a noticeable perf regression on streaming token latency for the /v1/chat/stream route since yesterday's runtime change. server-side per-token median moved from ~12ms -> ~22ms for long contexts.

jorge: yikes. any signal where the extra time is coming from? KV hits/misses? kernel swap? batching?

alyssa: initial flame + token-level breakdown shows two hotspots: a) KV lookup percentile tail at the start of each request (spike at token #0..5) b) an extra 6-8ms spend in the kernel selection path when sequence length > 512.

ravi: can you paste the token-level histogram? also, are clients reporting chunk gaps or is it purely server emit time?

alyssa: pasted below (trimmed):
```
token_index, p50_ms, p95_ms
0, 18, 120
1, 14, 60
2-10, 12, 40
>50, 11, 28
```
we also see client-side stream ack timing shows small jitter but the bulk of added latency is server-side.

marie: interesting — the kernel probe we added last week toggles between optimized-matmul and fallback for certain attention shapes. might be that the probe path adds synchronous work for long sequences.

jorge: historically kernel-selection overhead is ~1-2ms, not 6-8ms. Could be extra serialization or a blocking KV cache miss validation step.

alyssa: observability traces show a `kv.lookup.validate` call that runs right before kernel selection for cached prefixes. p95 there is ~5-7ms.

ravi: ok. action: add a token-level span for `kv.lookup` vs `kernel.select` vs `emit`. also split client vs server clocks on the stream envelope so we can tell transport vs compute.

observability-bot: noted — creating temporary Grafana dashboard `rt/stream-token-split` with panels: per-token p50/p95, kv-hit-rate by token index, kernel-selection latency, client-ack lag.

marie: can we also add a per-route KPI: tokens_emitted_per_sec, server_token_latency_p50/p95, kv_miss_rate, kernel_swap_rate? want to track regression across routes (chat vs completions).

alyssa: yes — i'm going to add a PromQL set for the dashboard. proposal:
```
# per-token p95 (server-side)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(server_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/stream"}[1m])) by (le, token_index))

# kv miss rate by token index
sum(rate(kv_lookup_total{result="miss",route="/v1/chat/stream"}[5m])) by (token_index)
```

jorge: small note — token_index as a label will create high cardinality. prefer bucketing (0,1-5,6-50,>50) or attach `token_phase` label computed in runtime.

ravi: agree. we should avoid exploding prometheus series. runtime can emit `token_phase` with values `prefix`, `prompt`, `generation` which maps to rough index ranges. then dashboards can show phase-level p95.

alyssa: will change runtime telemetry. also adding a lightweight event counter when kernel selection falls back so we can graph kernel_fallback_rate.

marie: for KV: can we add a fast-path that skips `validate` on well-known cached prefixes if `cache_ttl` is fresh? the validate step seems redundant sometimes.

jorge: dev warning — bypassing validate risks serving stale cached KV in edge cases. maybe add a sampling flag: `kv.validate_sample_rate=0.01` and ramp up if false positives occur.

alyssa: good call. i'll add sample-based validation first. instrumentation plan:
- emit `server_token_latency_seconds` with `token_phase`, `kernel` labels
- emit `kv_lookup_total` with `result`, `token_phase`
- emit `kernel_select_latency_seconds` histogram and `kernel_fallback_total` counter
- instrument stream envelope with `server_emit_ts` and accept client `client_recv_ts` to compute transport delta

ravi: add a synthetic user test that opens a 1k-token stream and measures server vs client split at multiple seq lengths (64, 256, 1024). bot can run against dedicated staging.

observability-bot: scheduled synthetic run `stream-split-run-1967` in staging at 12:30 PST.

jorge: after metrics are in, we should create an alert: if server_token_p95 increases > 2x baseline for any route for 10m -> create incident candidate. keep threshold conservative to avoid noise.

alyssa: noted. I'll land the telemetry branch with `kv.validate_sample_rate=0.01` + `token_phase` labels and a Grafana temp dashboard. PR coming in ~1h. cc @ravi @jorge for review. :thumbsup:

ravi: quick review plan: focus on cardinality and making sure labels are dimensionally bounded. also check for any sync disk/metric writes in the hot path.

marie: once we have the data, we should run a root-cause experiment: toggle kernel_probe off and then toggle sample validation to see which flip reduces p95. record the comparison in the dashboard.

alyssa: thanks all — will post updates here. deploy-bot: please annotate the deploy with `observability:stream-token-split` when the telemetry branch is merged.

deploy-bot: noted — will attach annotation on merge.

alyssa: final note — prioritizing server-side split and KV fast-path. if we still see >15% regression after changes, we may roll the kernel_probe back.

jorge: sg, thanks.
